# Diagram Design — pinned upstream dependency

- Repository: https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design
- Exact pinned commit: `7a2e22170ee838e859d8142ba825d83f8b6375e6`
- Immutable source permalink: https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design/tree/7a2e22170ee838e859d8142ba825d83f8b6375e6
- License: MIT. The upstream copyright notice is preserved in `LICENSE`.
- What we use: semantic diagram selection, editorial SVG conventions, explicit cardinality, orthogonal connectors, restrained focal accents, and clear source/unknown labeling.
- Pin policy: this is a snapshot reference, not a floating dependency. Review changes before updating the SHA.
- Atlas adaptation: the diagrams use Atlas-specific semantics. We are not treating any proposed service, entity, API, or data-store choice as deployed fact.

## Style decision
The previous Atlas prototypes overused a green accent without an approved brand decision. The diagram theme now starts from a neutral ivory/graphite editorial base with a restrained burnt-orange focal accent and steel-blue interaction links. Light and dark modes use separate semantic tokens. These are still review tokens, not a finalized brand system.
